## Fixed

- `model`: a plan whose only light fill is a blob no longer cuts the storey to
  nothing. The envelope is the building box every storey is cut to, and it was
  taken to be the largest light fill on the ground-floor plan whatever its
  size. On dossier 12 that is a 0.01 m² pale-blue scrap, so the box became the
  scrap: the storey came back with no walls and a 0.01 m² slab, marked
  `empty`, from a sheet that draws 33 wall fills, 15 of them wall-shaped
  bands. The light fill now has to be at least as
  large as the widest wall band it is supposed to contain, and where none is,
  the building box falls back to the outline of the walls and rooms — which is
  what a plan drawing no light fill at all already did, and the `warnings`
  entry naming the page is the same one. Dossier 12 goes from a hollow storey
  to 24 walls on a 58 m² slab; every other set in the corpus, the reference
  dossier and the sketch set included, reads exactly as before. Reading the
  palette across all the plan sheets rather than off the ground plan was tried
  first and rejected on the corpus: one sheet's beige hatch becomes another
  storey's envelope, which cost two sets more than it gave back.

## Changed

- Workspace version 0.15.0, which `docs/json-api.md` now describes. No field is
  added, renamed or removed; the `params_notes` example it prints is refreshed
  from the current run.
